description: Read your account's security log, newest first: sign-ins, sign-outs, devices signed out, password changes, email change requests, and API keys you created or revoked, each with when, the browser and system, and an approximate location. For older entries pass the cursor the previous answer gave as before. Your own account, not a workspace: needs a person's sign-in token (LASTPRICE_JWT from POST /api/auth/native-token); an API key or an agent's token is refused. Answers only while the security log is switched on for your account (being rolled out).

before.description: The cursor the previous page returned, for older events.

limit.description: Most events to return. Defaults to 20.

name: list_security_events
